title: Continuum UDF v1 (frozen)
description: Unified Dialogue Format — the only input format of the Continuum core. Contract: field names and semantics are frozen; new optional fields require UDF_VERSION bump.

ts.description: ISO8601 timestamp with timezone. Adapters MUST provide millisecond-or-better precision — (session_id, ts, role, content_hash) is the idempotent re-append key; second-precision timestamps can conflate distinct identical messages.

host.description: Host agent identifier, lowercase kebab-case, e.g. workbuddy, claude-code, codex

session_id.description: Host-side external session id (opaque to core)

content.description: Verbatim message body. Never rewritten by core.
